payload.title: sensor-service GraphQL resolvers decide access by tenant and global account role only: sensors, readings, edge devices and their federation references are served to every authenticated tenant member with no sensor-module decision and no site scope, and SiteAuthorizationService has no caller in sensor-service
evidence: apps/sensor-service/src/app.module.ts:507 (global guards are ServiceIdentity, Tenant, Roles and opt-in TenantPermission; none decides a module, :507-536)
apps/sensor-service/src/sensor/resolvers/sensor.resolver.ts:85 (sensor by id has no role decorator and filters by tenantId only)
apps/sensor-service/src/sensor/resolvers/sensor.resolver.ts:174 (readings over any sensor id and time range, tenant filter only)
apps/sensor-service/src/edge-device/edge-device.resolver.ts:98 (edgeDevices takes siteId as an optional client filter; when it is absent, every site is returned)
apps/sensor-service/src/sensor/resolvers/sensor-reading.resolver.ts:76 (the SensorReading federation reference resolves on tenantId only)
libs/backend-common/src/security/site-authorization.service.ts:67 (resolveSiteScope exists, but grep finds zero uses in apps/sensor-service)
payload.rule_violated: D2 (readings, devices, edge devices and PLC/SCADA are sensor-private and need the sensor grant) and the decided default that a site assignment restricts every module where the user is MODULE_USER.
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-11, release R5.
